## Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of the limitation or need. (Reference relevant section of `GEMINI.md`).

## Proposed Solution
Architectural description of the proposed interface, port, or adapter.

## Invariants & Security Boundary
- Does this require model execution?
- Does this introduce new capabilities or tools?
- How is fail-closed behavior preserved?

## Alternatives Considered
Other approaches evaluated and reasons for rejection.
